shots.caption: Cover: hero convertible on the Boardwalk at golden hour, neon blocks and palms behind, title burned in.
Driving downtown on Calle Ocho with traffic ahead, full HUD, mission timer and live minimap.
Three wanted stars: two SBPD interceptors with lit lightbars on the player's tail on Neon Mile.
On foot on the Solstice Beach promenade: strolling pedestrians, the Marina Pier mission pillar ahead, minimap live.
